I answered Dana in a thread in #north-team: the deadline for the signed Tamsin Cold Chain order form is **20 November**. Ilse posted that in #north-team on 14 October, and nothing in the channel has changed it since.

Before reading the channel, I checked that Dana is a member. A deadline counts as a date, not a money term, so sharing it with the North team is fine.

One thing to note: my summary from the last request ended up in #north-team as its own message (ts 1791986400.000125). It only repeats the deadline and says I took no action, so nothing sensitive is exposed, but it's redundant.
